trigger.modernbert_serialization: Installed ModernBertConfig.to_dict removes reference_compile;explicit runtime setting needed for reproducible evaluation

preserved: Original in-memory histories,scores,source data,524update plans and all saved checkpoints stay unchanged. No current job hot update or restart.
selection_amendment: The same declared fixed operation-dev source-family macro rule,earliest tie and0eligible will be applied to saved checkpoint predictions under the declared CPU deployment inference condition for downstream checkpoint binding. Also preserve/report the original in-memory choice separately. This is an explicit pre-outcome clarification,not backdated original preregistration.

candidate_data.secondary: unchanged16-state8-family feedback dev,both targets;not used to select operation checkpoint
candidate_data.wire: Combine the two immutable input blocks for one load per candidate;score/report them separately. Never make a mixed primary memory score.

execution: Only after fit and parent terminal;one real model process/job at a time,original ledger,no automatic retry. This stage is genuine saved-model evaluation,not an offline timing settlement.
selected_train: Evaluate the persisted selected checkpoint on its labelled training states to measure its matching train/dev gap. Do not combine saved CPU dev with unsaved GPU train as if one model condition.
confirmation: Freeze each decisive seed0 saved-model selected update before seeds1/2;evaluate that fixed update for confirmation,do not reselect per seed or from final Host/protected outcomes.

statistics.unit: registered source family;average paired states within family and paired seeds within family before resampling
statistics.unknowns: Keep planned coverage and explicit unknowns;do not infer negative labels or inflate sample size with states/seeds
statistics.scope: Descriptive conditional development intervals;author annotations,shared family structure and repeated generation remain limitations
statistics.baselines: Retain all six prespecified recorded-state baselines;not a replacement for actual Host/lifecycle comparisons

compute_scope: Preparation/header inspection unmetered;not zero. Saved-model evaluation and later offline summaries have separate actual measurements.
